about: Single-fault negatives (expect REVISE or REJECT). Each changes exactly ONE field of one positive in positives.json; `base` lists the positives it can be built from in preference order, and `alt` rephrases the fault for a given base (`field` is a dot path; `value` may use the same {{key}} placeholders). `expect` names the layer that should catch it: code (gates.ts) or judge (the LLM judge, or the heuristic stub judge in stub mode). Never edit items to make the judge pass.
